title: Flavour current correlators and the non-Abelian hydrodynamic approximation: the charged sector
summary: Flavor-current correlators are studied in strongly-coupled dense (holographic) matter, at finite quark chemical potential $μ_q$ and finite isospin asymmetry. The non-Abelian hydrodynamic description of the charged currents is derived in the presence of an isospin chemical potential $μ_3$. The two-point correlators of charged currents are then computed holographically at finite quark and isospin chemical potentials.
